cmd.chains.help: Dweba ithebula lamaketango ezindlulamthwalo: izinombolo zamaketango ngephitshi, ububanzi bamaroli, ububanzi bangaphakathi kanye nobude bamapuleti, nokuthi amakhathalogi amingaki avumelana.
cmd.chainsources.help: Bonisa amakhathalogi asemphakathini ayefundwe kuwo izilinganiso zamaketango.
cmd.sprocket.help: Dweba isiphethu seketango lezindlulamthwalo ngenombolo yeketango nenani lamazinyo: umugqa wesigaba samazinyo, isiyingi sephitshi, imigqa yesikhungo kanye nembobo.
chains.head: Amaketango ezindlulamthwalo: imigqa {n}. Amamilimitha. p = iphitshi, d1 = ububanzi beroli (ibhushingi lezi-25 nezi-35), b1 = ububanzi phakathi kwamapuleti angaphakathi, h2 = ubude bepuleti elingaphakathi.
chains.agree: okungenani amakhathalogi {n} avumelana ngo-p, d1, b1
chains.foot: Kufundwe kumakhathalogi asemphakathini, kugcinwe lapho ababili bevumelana; akukopiwe ku-ISO 606 noma ku-ASME B29.1. CHAINSOURCES iwadwebela.
src.head: Amakhathalogi ethebula lamaketango afundwe kuwo (alandwe {date}):
src.not_standard: Lawa ayizikhasi zabakhiqizi nezezinkomba. Asinayo i-ISO 606 noma i-ANSI/ASME B29.1 futhi lutho lapha lukopishwe kuzo.
err.chain: Akukho ketango {name} ethebulini. Thayipha CHAINS ukuze ubone izinombolo zamaketango ezikhona.
err.teeth: Isiphethu sidinga inani eliphelele lamazinyo, okungenani angu-6.
err.bore: Imbobo kumele ibe okungenani 0 futhi icace isiyingi sempande.
done: Isiphethu seketango {chain}, amazinyo {n}: ububanzi bephitshi {D}, ububanzi bempande {Df}, ububanzi bezinhloko {Dt} mm.
mesh.ok: Ihlolwe ngeketango elenzelwe lona: amaroli ahlala ngokufanele futhi acace umugqa ngokungenani {gap} mm.
mesh.bad: Ukuhlola kuhlulekile: ketango alihlali kahle kulesi samazinyo. Zama amazinyo amaningi.
note.tooth: Imumo yezinyo ingeyalolu sengezo lwayo (ukucaca kokuhlala {c} %, ingxenye yengelosi yokuhlala {beta} amadigri, ithiphu {tip} p ngaphezu kwesiyingi sephitshi), hhayi imumo yezinyo yomgomo. Yihlole nomhlinzeki wakho wesiphethu ngaphambi kokusika.
note.noplate: Ubude bepuleti laleli ketango akuvunywa amakhathalogi amabili futhi luyashiywa; aluSetshenziswa kumugqa wesigaba.
